scope: Final candidate native crop scheduling at equal physical plots and growth callbacks
method: Three fresh JVMs per artifact in B1/A1/A2/B2/B3/A3 order; Java25/G1/4GiB/16processors/compactheadersOFF/JFR; 1024 warmup and4096 measured ticks per scale.
limitations: Owned gameplay clients and endurance server closed before measurements; unrelated user game/services unchanged.
This measures crop work on the server thread; it does not measure whole-modpack FPS. Maxima are sensitive to GC and OS scheduling.

precedingBaselineParity.r4Change: 24metadata entries only; every fixture class byte-identical to r3
precedingBaselineParity.r5Change: One unmeasured input-label class and23language catalogs; every crop fixture class byte-identical to r4
precedingBaselineParity.r6Change: Only ExtendedValidation workload preparation differs; measured crop instructions identical

fixtureParity.method: Every final crop observer/fixture class is byte-identical to the instruction-parity-checked r6 candidate; no benchmark instructions changed.

data.method: Actual forced native farm chunks, normal placed crop ticking, 256-tick growth cadence, identical bounded high-duration species observer, exact per-plot call counts; fresh warmed JVMs. Random block ticking disabled for equal soil and no unrelated age changes.
